evidence.observation: Any number of partial misses alone is insufficient to propose novelty. ... Check that the first search yields zero rows, the next finds the known included fact, and ambiguous evidence yields defer with no added fact.
A subset miss requires broader investigation or deferral before asserting novelty.

concerns.recommendation: Scope the obligation to what the packaged example demonstrates, or add an example scenario in which repeated partial misses end in deferral with no novelty assertion, and mark the rule as advisory host protocol in the packaged guide rather than a demonstrated property.
concerns.title: Partial-miss novelty guard is asserted for any number of misses but demonstrated only for one miss and one ambiguous case

evidence.observation: A compact rendering must be strictly smaller in UTF-8 bytes than both the original full_vocabulary.orm.yaml fixture and the ordinary review rendering of that same model. Report all three counts. No cross-corpus threshold is claimed.

concerns.recommendation: Pin the fixture by content digest inside the size test so the three reported counts are reproducible and the gate cannot drift silently when the fixture is edited, and state the fixture-scoped meaning of compact in the packaged guidance.
concerns.title: Compactness gate compares against an unpinned fixture and a source-format byte count rather than a guaranteed margin

evidence.observation: Expose object IDs and reference modes, fact IDs, readings and ordered named role players, direct subtype links and registered constraint signatures.
GC1 returns the exact object, fact and authored constraint IDs supplied by the loader, including the seed's IDs, with no generated aliases.

concerns.recommendation: Extend the identifier-completeness assertions to cover reference-mode fields and direct subtype pairs on the populated fixture, or state explicitly that existing fixture-equality checks subsume them.
concerns.title: Reference modes and direct subtype links are section 2 exposure obligations with no named assertion in the acceptance details

evidence.observation: Verify complete identifiers on fixtures, role order, guarded and anchored signatures, deterministic bytes, included elements, empty models, unresolved includes and evidence-only edits.
At close reconcile each of these criteria with its actual test or installed example.

concerns.recommendation: Add an empty-model case to the acceptance details, for example deterministic bytes of the empty view with the gnd-growth-view-v1 format field present and zero records, so close-time reconciliation cannot drop the GC1 obligation.
concerns.title: GC1 names an empty-model verification that the acceptance details never reconcile against a test

evidence.observation: Sort object and fact records by ID, subtype pairs by endpoints, constraints by canonical signature.
Serialize with sorted JSON keys, separators comma and colon without padding, unescaped Unicode, and a single final LF.

concerns.recommendation: Define the canonical signature string (operand order, delimiters, escaping) in the plan, or name the single shared helper that produces it, so constraint ordering is specified rather than implementation-defined.
concerns.title: Constraint ordering depends on an undefined canonical signature form while the document serialization is specified exactly

response.summary: Digest verified. Schema identity, compatibility and retry obligations are mostly paired with falsifiable evidence: root-byte and pin checks defeat evidence-only edits that preserve the view digest, default output is snapshot-verified, CLI/API parity is checked from an installed wheel, and the miss-hit-defer loop is exercised by a runnable example. Residual gaps: the any-number-of-partial-misses novelty guard is stronger than anything the stated evidence can falsify, the GC1 empty-model case has no acceptance-level check to reconcile against, reference-mode and subtype-link exposure is never asserted, the compactness gate compares against an unpinned fixture, and the constraint sort key canonical signature is undefined while document serialization is fully specified.
